{{Quote|Master&hellip;what happened?''"<br />"''Well&hellip;I guess that pirate brew is stronger than we thought.''"<br />"''I only took a sip.''"<br />"''We were drugged, obviously.|Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi as they wake up in a prison cell after drinking the pirate brew|audio=WeWereDrugged-TGG.flac|<ref name="TGG">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref>}}
This '''alcoholic beverage''' was popular with [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]]. It was green in color. During the [[Weequay banquet]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], Hondo's pirates were celebrating the capture of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and this brew was served to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Pirates tried to drug the Jedi, but Anakin and Obi-Wan used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to telekinetically swap their drinks with those of the flanking Weequay, who fell unconscious after imbibing.

At the end, they were still drugged by Hondo's pet [[Pilf Mukmuk/Legends|Pilf Mukmuk]].
